families.label: Volume / refill limitation
families.description: Pressure is sensitive to circulating volume when tissue refill cannot match removal.

families.label: Vascular compensation limitation
families.description: A changing resistance factor can explain falling pressure despite a better-preserved volume.

families.label: Cardiac response limitation
families.description: A changing output factor can explain pressure loss without the same refill limitation.

families.label: Mixed response hypothesis
families.description: An authored combination of volume sensitivity and changing compensation; it is not an identified clinical mixture.
